Set [tool.stepik-grader] ai_base_url and ai_model (the key lives in the env variable named by ai_api_key_env), e.g. ollama http://localhost:11434/v1 (no key) or a cloud OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Without configuration nothing is sent over the network. See https://github.com/ArtVsMark/Stepik-Python-Grader/blob/main/docs/use/grader-workflow.md.

cli_description: Stepik Python Grader — check and compare solutions.
cli_epilog:
Run:
  stepik-grader --mode 1 --file task.py          (after pip install)
  python -m stepik_grader --mode 1 --file task.py

Without --mode an interactive menu opens.

No task on disk? Download it from Stepik by step URL:
  python -m stepik_grader.downloader https://stepik.org/lesson/.../step/N

How a task is laid out (tests are looked up in tests/ next to the solution):
  task.py                 the solution
  tests/input_1.txt       input of the first case
  tests/expected_1.txt    expected output of the first case

Other test-case formats and ways to define them — https://github.com/ArtVsMark/Stepik-Python-Grader/blob/main/docs/use/configuration.md.

Launcher window without a command line: stepik-grader-gui (see stepik-grader-gui --help).
cli_help_ai_hints: After checking modes 1–4 show an AI explanation of failed cases (WA/RE; in benchmark modes 3/4 — solutions with an execution error) via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (BYOK, ADR-0003). Off by default; without ai_base_url/ai_model in pyproject.toml — a quiet skip with a hint. Nothing leaves the machine without configuration. Does not affect the verdict.
cli_help_cache: Cache --mode 1/2 results in .grader_cache/ and skip unchanged solutions (--no-cache disables it). Defaults to [tool.stepik-grader] use_cache; under --watch --mode 2 it is on automatically (incremental re-run).
cli_help_compare: How to compare output with the expectation: stepik — like the platform checker (trailing spaces and trailing blank lines are insignificant), strict — byte-for-byte, line by line. Overrides [tool.stepik-grader] compare_mode for this run.
cli_help_config: Configuration file ([tool.stepik-grader]) instead of auto-discovery. Takes priority over STEPIK_GRADER_CONFIG and the tree search; without the flag pyproject.toml is looked up from the working directory upwards to the project boundary.
cli_help_diagnostic: Diagnostic log of network/OAuth/download into stepik_diagnostics/grader.log (secrets redacted). Same as the STEPIK_GRADER_LOG=debug variable.
cli_help_dir: Path to the folder with solutions (required for --mode 2/3/4).
cli_help_export_progress: Export progress aggregates (attempts/time to the first AC per task, verdict and failure-kind counters — without solution sources) from .grader_history.db into a self-contained grader-progress.md/.html/.json file and exit. json is a machine format with a stable schema: it is aggregated across a group of students without parsing the markup.
cli_help_file: Path to the solution file (required for --mode 1).
cli_help_history: Write the run history (modes/cases/verdicts) to the local SQLite database .grader_history.db (--no-history disables it). Defaults to [tool.stepik-grader] record_history. Powers the “Rules”/“Practice” sections, local only.
cli_help_import_reference: Import the pinned Stepik solution (+ the most liked ones) from the solutions thread into the task folder as task{N}_{100+}.py for comparison in modes 2–4 and exit. Reads meta.json from TASK_DIR (a downloaded task and OAuth are needed).
cli_help_import_top: How many most-liked solutions to import on top of the pinned one (--import-reference). Default 5; solutions with zero likes are not taken.
cli_help_init_vscode: Generate .vscode/tasks.json in the current folder (grading from VS Code via Ctrl+Shift+B).
cli_help_insights: Show the summary of “Practice” cards (frequent mistakes and how they fade) from the accumulated run history and exit. Requires --history enabled. Honours --output json — the summary can be consumed by a script.
cli_help_lang: Language of the menu and messages (default ru).
cli_help_lint: After checking modes 1/2 show the “Style” block — PEP 8 violations from ruff (requires extra: pip install stepik-python-grader[lint]). Does not affect the verdict.
cli_help_memory_limit: Memory limit for the solution in megabytes; 0 — no limit. Overrides [tool.stepik-grader] max_memory_mb for this run.
cli_help_mode: Run mode (without --mode the interactive menu is shown).
cli_help_no_root_confinement: Disable checking request paths against --root — access to any path on disk, as before. An explicit opt-out by the user, not the default.
cli_help_output: Output format: text (default), json/csv for CI pipelines or markdown for reports.
cli_help_purge_history: Delete the local learning history (.grader_history.db) and the statistics journal (.grader_stats.jsonl) and exit. With an argument — only the runs of the given task; statistics are left untouched in that case.
cli_help_quiet: Summary only, without the detailed diff, for --mode 1/2.
cli_help_revoke_ai_consent: Revoke consent to send code to the AI provider and exit. The next --ai-hints will ask for consent again.
cli_help_root: Working directory for --serve: request paths outside it are rejected with 403 (defaults to the cwd at startup).
cli_help_sandbox: Execute --mode 1/2/3/4 solutions in an OS-isolated sandbox (SandboxRunner) instead of a plain subprocess — bubblewrap on Linux, sandbox-exec on macOS, Job Objects on Windows. Guarantees differ per OS (see https://github.com/ArtVsMark/Stepik-Python-Grader/blob/main/SECURITY.md); if the backend is unavailable on this machine — an explicit error, without silently falling back to a plain run.
cli_help_serve: Start the local web interface (localhost only) instead of the CLI.
cli_help_stats: Write local run statistics (mode/verdicts/OS) to .grader_stats.jsonl (--no-stats disables it). Defaults to [tool.stepik-grader] record_stats. Local only, no network.
cli_help_stats_summary: Show a summary of local run statistics and exit.
cli_help_timeout: Timeout of a single solution run in seconds — overrides [tool.stepik-grader] timeout_seconds for this run. Without a project file (pipx installation) this is the only way to set it.
cli_help_verbose: Verbose output with diff for --mode 1/2 (for --mode 1 this is already the default).
cli_help_version: Show the grader version and exit.
cli_help_watch: Re-run --mode 1/2 when the solution file changes (requires: pip install stepik-python-grader[watch]). For --mode 2 the re-run is incremental — the cache runs only the changed file (--no-cache disables it).

launcher_cli_description: Launcher window for the grader web interface: pick the language, isolation, run-history recording, port and working folder, then start the server and open the browser.
launcher_cli_epilog:
Everything else is chosen in the window itself — the command line only opens it.
The full grader CLI is the stepik-grader command (see stepik-grader --help).

   No task yet? Download it from Stepik — menu item 8 or python -m stepik_grader.downloader.
   Or manually: put a task1.py file with your solution next to a tests/ folder.
